image_description: A close-up, high-resolution shot of two common iguanas (Iguana iguana) resting closely together. The foreground iguana is in sharp focus, displaying detailed head scales, a large subtympanic shield, and a prominent dewlap area. A second iguana's head is visible immediately behind the first, slightly out of focus. The background consists of blurred green foliage and dark branches.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is large and triangular with a prominent dewlap (loose skin fold) hanging from the throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head shape is clearly triangular and robust. The throat area shows the characteristic loose skin texture of a dewlap, although it is tucked against the body/rock rather than fully extended.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are large with round pupils and golden irises.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Both visible eyes exhibit large size, round pupils, and yellowish-golden iris coloration consistent with the species.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: A large circular subtympanic shield (scale) is present below the tympanum.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The large, distinct circular scale located below the ear opening (tympanum) is clearly visible on the foreground subject.
The image is a tight crop focusing on the heads; the main torso/body volume is largely occluded or outside the frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Coloration is bright green in juveniles, becoming darker green to greyish-green in adults with broad black bands on the body and tail.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The subjects display adult coloration: muted greyish-green/brown tones rather than bright juvenile green. While full body bands aren't visible, the head/neck coloration matches the adult phase description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Row of enlarged, spine-like scales running from the nape along the midline of the back to the tail base, forming a serrated crest.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The beginning of the dorsal crest (spines) is visible starting at the nape of the neck on both subjects, confirming the anatomical feature.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is covered in small, granular scales with larger, plate-like scales on the head.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Texture analysis confirms heterogeneous scaling: fine granular scales on the neck/body transition and large, polygonal plate-like scales on the snout and cheeks.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are long and muscular with five clawed digits on each foot.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Limbs and feet are completely occluded by the body position and the rock surface; digits cannot be counted or verified.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and longer than body, used for balance and defense.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is not visible in this close-up composition.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the junction where the two iguana heads meet. AI often struggles with overlapping identical textures, leading to 'fusion' artifacts. Verify if the scales maintain logical orientation across both subjects. Also, check the eye reflections; inconsistent lighting in the eyes can indicate compositing errors.
